title: 歩行型の床洗浄機
description: 公共施設や店舗の床清掃シーン向けの歩行型洗浄機。円形ブラシ、成形タンク、操作ハンドル、実形状の湾曲スクイージー、排水・吸引ホースを備えます。液体、内部ポンプ、洗浄・吸引・走行はなく、衛生・電気安全や床適合性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.778 × 1.128 × 1.250 m、23,920三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A walk-behind scrubber for public-building and retail floor-cleaning scenes, with a disc brush, molded tanks, operator handle, curved squeegee and fixed drain/suction hoses. No liquid, internal pump, scrubbing, suction or driving behavior is included; hygiene, electrical safety and floor compatibility are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.778 × 1.128 × 1.250 m; 23,920 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
